name: unsafe fn drop_in_place < T : ? Sized > (to_drop : * mut T)
rule: `drop_in_place` may be used to drop pinned data when `T` is not `repr(packed)`, provided the pinned data has not been moved before it is dropped.
api: unsafe fn drop_in_place < T : ? Sized > (to_drop : * mut T)
